excerpt: Literati runs kids' book clubs by subscription and school book fairs in the US. Plans from $11.95, history, funding and alternatives.
content:
Literati is an Austin, Texas company built around children's books. Its main consumer product is a kids' book club: each month five books, chosen by reading level and interests, are sent to the child's home, and families keep the ones they want. Its website says plans start at $11.95. Literati also runs school book fairs, in person and online, a school store where 10% of purchases goes back to the school, online fundraisers for educators, and plans for teachers. The site claims more than 1 million books donated, more than $12 million raised for educators and schools, and more than 10 million families and educators served; these are its own figures.

Literati was founded by Jessica Ewing, a former Google product manager, who is its chief executive. In January 2021 TechCrunch reported a $40 million Series B led by Aydin Senkut of Felicis Ventures, with 01 Advisors, Founders Fund, General Catalyst, Shasta, Silverton Partners, Springdale Ventures and basketball player Stephen Curry; the company had earlier raised about $12 million. At that time it also ran adult book clubs curated by figures including Malala Yousafzai, Stephen Curry and Richard Branson. Publishers Weekly reported in November 2023 that Literati's branded virtual book clubs closed in December 2022 after about 18 months, while its children's subscription boxes continued with about 50,000 subscribers.

In January 2022 Literati bought Follett Book Fairs, which had announced it was closing. Publishers Weekly reported that Literati took over the brand, inventory, three fulfilment centres in Dallas, Redlands and Elgin, and 23 employees, and relaunched the business as Literati Book Fairs for PreK-8 schools.

Literati operates in the US.

This profile is put together from the company's own pages and published reporting, checked on 15 October 2026. We have not tested the product, and nothing here is paid placement.
